Name: Hauling: The Old Regulator on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: The crew lead at the water reclaimer gave me their old pressure regulator. A scrapper at the <Alias=TargetLocation> will pay for it, and she wants a fair price.

LogEntries.Entry: The crew lead at the water reclaimer gave me their old pressure regulator. A scrapper at the <Alias=TargetLocation> will pay for it, and she wants a fair price.
I sold the water reclaimer crew's old regulator to the scrapper at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. He's paying them direct, and he means to find out what's inside it.
I sold the water reclaimer crew's old regulator to the scrapper at the <Alias=TargetLocation> and talked him up. He's paying them direct.

Objectives.DisplayText: Sell the old regulator to the scrapper at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: Is that the reclaimer regulator? Let me see. Nobody can make what's inside these any more.
More than most working kit. I'll pay the crew direct, and something for your trouble on top.
Whatever you're about to offer, it's worth more.
It is. Fine, a little more, and I'll pay the crew direct.
Nobody can make the parts inside it any more. Somebody should be able to.
What will you do with it?
Take it apart very slowly, and write down everything I find.
If it's broken, I'll look at it. If it's working, why are you here?
